sources.entry: NØTH - Turns the MacBook notch into live activities and a command center for music, files, clipboard, calendar, notes and tools. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/manugowda19/noth) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon] ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: NØTH is a native macOS app that turns the MacBook notch into a hover-activated command center for music, files, clipboard, calendar, timers, notes and everyday tools.
summary.what_it_does: NØTH shows a black pill over the MacBook notch that expands when something is happening, such as now-playing media with album art, audio bars and synced lyrics, Pomodoro or stopwatch timers, download progress, camera or microphone use, or battery and display connections. Hovering gives quick controls, and dropping a file on the notch parks it on a Shelf. Clicking the notch or pressing ⌥⌘J opens a Command Center with five tabs: Home (media, calendar, pinned links, notes, focus timer), Shelf (files, clipboard history, snippets), Media (lyrics, sound output, focus noise), Time (stopwatch, reminders, timeline, screen time), and Tools (color picker, QR scanner, emoji, Quick bar calculator and search, system stats, app launcher, Bluetooth battery levels). Settings toggles each feature, and optional global shortcuts cover notes, Pomodoro, screenshots, mic mute and window snapping. The README says network features (weather, lyrics lookup, site icons, update checks, web search) are off by default and clipboard history is memory-only and off by default.
use_cases: replace the menu bar with a notch-based control panel
control music playback and read synced lyrics
park files temporarily and drag them later
run Pomodoro focus sessions from the notch
keep a clipboard history and snippets
scan QR codes and pick colors on macOS
check battery levels of Bluetooth devices
how_to_run: git clone https://github.com/manugowda19/noth (URL as given in README; clone line appears truncated)
Or download Noth-3.1.0.dmg from the latest release, drag Noth to Applications, then right-click Noth > Open > Open on first launch
stack: cmake (optional, enables Now Playing for every app)
mediaremote-adapter (BSD-3-Clause, for Now Playing on macOS 15.4+)
notable: Notch-native UI that stays black and blends with the hardware until activity appears
Private by default: no servers, no account, no telemetry, network features opt-in
Clipboard history kept in memory only and skips items marked concealed by password managers
Five-tab Command Center plus hover strip and file drop onto the notch
Universal build for Apple silicon and Intel, with tag-triggered release DMG publishing
caveats: Not notarized yet; first launch requires right-click Open and a paid Apple Developer account is needed for notarization
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later; on Macs without a notch it appears as a small pill at top of screen (less tested)
Lock-screen card and brightness control use private macOS APIs and may stop working in future macOS versions
Updates are announced but not installed automatically
